3cfd51cd5df9.title: Glosario
3cfd51cd5df9.content: 1 / 1 términos redactados traducidos por completo. Estas traducciones no son oficiales: las redactó un agente y ninguna persona las ha aprobado todavía (issue #206). El texto marcado como sin traducir es el original, que se muestra en lugar de ocultarse.

5ad2f32fb9b2.title: Already somebody else’s concept? (sin traducir)
5ad2f32fb9b2.content: Extracted candidates are minted from this repository’s own assets and are not, by themselves, checked against any vocabulary. check:term-mapping asks whether each already exists as a concept somebody is authoritative for — SKOS for what a term MEANS, FHIR for a clinical code’s operational semantics — and the two are separate questions with separate answers. (sin traducir) . The table’s labels are in the source language: it reports counts per scheme, computed by the gate rather than authored here. (sin traducir) . Already somebody else's concept? — check:term-mapping, bean 7wou | target | mapped | unmapped | undetermined | why undetermined | . | fhir | 0 | 203 | 0 | — | . | skos | 0 | 203 | 0 | — | . Undetermined is never “no match”. A vocabulary that could not be reached has said nothing, and the column above keeps that apart from a checked miss. The counts are reported and not graded: an unmapped candidate may be a term this corpus is right to coin.

1960660ea22e.title: Páginas
1960660ea22e.content: Los candidatos extraídos no se traducen: se toman literalmente de los recursos del grafo de conocimiento y no están revisados. Sus páginas están en el idioma de origen. El glosario en el idioma de origen, con todos los términos extraídos.
